name: MNT-0003 Green Replay

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - automation/mnt-0003-green-replay-20260907
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/mnt-0003-green-replay.yml

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  replay:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout replay branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: automation/mnt-0003-green-replay-20260907

      - name: Configure Git identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "Monad EOS Automation"
          git config user.email "eos-automation@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Apply validated production integration
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/mnt0003_integrate_patch.py
          python3 tools/eos/mnt0003_integrate_fix.py

      - name: Validate exact production file set
        run: |
          python3 -m py_compile \
            tools/eos/event_ledger.py \
            tools/eos/canonical_state.py \
            tools/eos/verification_v2.py \
            scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py \
            tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_canonical_state.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_canonical_reconciliation.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_wrapper_dispatch.py
          python3 tools/eos/test_identifier_families.py
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py
          ./scripts/eos verify
          git diff --check -- . ':!.eos/*.tsv'

      - name: Commit green production files
        run: |
          git add \
            tools/eos/event_ledger.py \
            tools/eos/canonical_state.py \
            tools/eos/verification_v2.py \
            scripts/reconcile-eos-canonical-state.py \
            tools/eos/test_event_ledger_merge.py
          git diff --cached --check
          git commit -m "fix(eos): enforce event history integrity"

      - name: Publish immutable green result ref
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/automation/mnt-0003-green-result-20260907
